title: Self-Improvement of Large Language Models: A Technical Overview and Future Outlook
abstract: arXiv:2603.25681v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, improving them solely through human supervision is becoming increasingly costly and limited in scalability. As models approach human-level capabilities in certain domains, human feedback may no longer provide sufficiently informative signals for further improvement. At the same time, the growing ability of models to make autonomous decisions and execute complex actions naturally enables abstractions in which components of the model development process can be progressively automated. Together, these challenges and opportunities have driven increasing interest in self-improvement, where models autonomously generate data, evaluate outputs, and iteratively refine their own capabilities. In this paper, we present a system-level perspective on self-improving language models and introduce a unified framework that organizes existing techniques. We conceptualize the self-improvement system

translated_title: 大型语言模型的自我改进：技术综述与未来展望
translated_abstract: 摘要：随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的持续进步，仅通过人类监督来改进它们变得越来越昂贵且扩展性受限。当模型在特定领域接近人类水平能力时，人类反馈可能不再提供足够信息丰富的信号以支持进一步改进。同时，模型自主决策和执行复杂行动的能力日益增强，自然使得模型开发过程中的组件能够逐步自动化，从而实现抽象化。这些挑战和机遇共同推动了人们对自我改进的兴趣日益增长，即模型自主生成数据、评估输出并迭代优化自身能力。在本文中，我们从系统层面视角审视自我改进的语言模型，并引入一个统一框架来组织现有技术。我们将自我改进系统概念化。
tldr: 本文系统性地综述了大型语言模型自我改进的技术，并提出一个统一框架来组织和理解这些方法，展望了未来发展方向。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a systematic overview of self-improvement techniques for large language models, proposing a unified framework to organize and understand these methods, with a forward-looking perspective on future developments.
